text_post: Hey guys, Just waking up this morning and realizing I might have found something I'm good at! For the first time in my life, I went out last night with the sole mission of sarging HBs and think I did pretty good. I didn't close any numbers but only because I forgot to try. I went to a local bar/club and just started gaming on just about every girl I saw. The openings were easy but I would find my self getting stuck in mid-game. But, if a conversation lost it's momentum or she walked away, I shrugged and moved on to the next one. To me, this mission was about getting out there and giving it a shot.  I spent most of the night out on the patio sipping on a beer and talking to whoever was next to me; groups of dudes who were keeping to themselves. So I'd chat with them then when a HB walked by I'd try to run some game. Randomly there was a single playing card laying on the ground face up so I kicked it over. As HB's or 2 sets walked by I'd come up with a neg nick name for them and ask if they like to gamble...most, if not all would stop dead, look at me and say "of course!" or something very positive. Then I'd ask them if they were to make a wager with me what they'd want if they won, most said drinks or $20 bucks. I would challenge them to guess what the suit of the card was on the ground and I won the bet everytime. Some of them, smarter than others would say something about me knowing what it is but usually in a playful way. Anyway, I used that bit probably on 10 different sets with positive results 9 times. I made out with 2 different girls and had great flirty chats with the rest. It was a productive night. I'd also chat up dudes who would then introduce me to chicks in their group which is a great lead in. I'm just some guy who the biggest or coolest guy in the group wants everyone else to know, and then they're putty in my hands. I would just crack a joke with the guys and all of a sudden I'm mackin' on their girlfriends. It was great! I did realize though that I really need to get a few more openers and routines memorized and practiced so that I can pick up a pace a bit. Not only did I hesitate with some girls or sets because I wasn't sure what to use, I was also working with some time constraints as bars here close at 2am but don't get busy until at least midnight. Sorry if this is a bad report, like I said I'm brand new in the game and just wanted to tell you about my first sarging experience. This is something I think I could get really good at and just want to keep practicing! Thanks for reading and if you have any advice, tips or links please let me know! Cheers, Media
